contractBoundary: This is consumer policy, not the receipt-v1 wire contract. Current receipt-v1 carries signed findings and coverage gaps, not a verdict. The verdictActions mapping below is retained for legacy v2 compatibility/policy projection only. Current integrations use POST /receipt/v1 and verify each axis separately.
appliesTo: routing a user toward a token
passing a token to another agent
storing a receipt for later use

verdictActions.pass: proceed only if required evidence is present AND coverage gaps are acceptable under the agent's own policy
verdictActions.pass_with_info_finding: same as pass; informational findings reviewed
verdictActions.warning: require escalation or explicit human approval
verdictActions.verifier_error: do not proceed; retry later or request access/support

verdictActionsAreIntegratorPolicy: The mappings in verdictActions are the INTEGRATOR's own default policy, not Raven authorizations. Raven issues scope-bounded evidence receipts; it never authorizes, permits, approves, or greenlights an action. Reading a Raven output as permission to act is a misuse of the product.
axesNeverCollapsed: signer trust (a key the consumer pins independently)
coverage (scope performed, not performed, and declared gaps)
consumer policy (is this evidence sufficient for me?)
axesNeverCollapsedRule: These six questions are answered separately and MUST NOT be reduced to a single boolean, score, or badge. A valid, fresh, fully covered receipt is still not permission to act.
coverageGapRule: coverageGaps is normative: listed surfaces were NOT evaluated. Never call a token safe when gaps exist; say 'not enough evidence for a full pass'. Missing optional evidence (metadataAddress, poolAddress) is a gap, never a pass.

reverify_when: receipt older than the agent's policy window
poolAddress missing in the prior receipt
metadataAddress missing in the prior receipt
about to spend, trade, list, route, or recommend escalation
engine version changed and the action is material
staleReceiptRule.note: No universal expiry is claimed; staleness is policy, not physics.

humanEscalationTriggers: missing pool evidence for a liquidity-dependent action
missing metadata evidence for a metadata-dependent action
handoff: POST /receipt/v1 -> verify payloadHash, receiptId, signature and expected subject -> match signerPublicKey to the independent pin (/pubkey cross-check only) -> store exact receipt + verifier result -> evaluate findings and gaps -> proceed, block, or escalate by consumer policy
noFinancialAdvice: Raven verifies token-launch evidence and returns signed receipts. It does not provide treasury, investment, trading, legal, or portfolio advice.
materialActionExamples: pass token to another wallet-capable agent

failClosedStates.legacy_v2_unknown_keyId: legacy compatibility only: cross-check /pubkey once against the independent pin; if still unknown, block
failClosedStates.rate_limited_429: fail closed; back off; no material action
failClosedStates.timeout_or_5xx: fail closed; back off; no material action
failClosedStates.context_conflict: preserve and surface the disagreement; re-observe, re-verify, or escalate — the receipt attests only to what Raven signed, not to external reality
failClosedStates.memory_conflict: preserve and surface the disagreement; re-observe, re-verify, or escalate — the receipt attests only to what Raven signed, not to agent memory

humanApprovalLimits: Human approval may approve a business action under consumer policy ONLY after receipt integrity, signer trust, subject, rules and freshness checks pass. Human approval cannot make an invalid, unsigned, tampered, or untrusted-signer receipt valid. Legacy v2 unknown-keyId receipts remain invalid.
deterministicRule: Decision policy is deterministic. LLM explanations may be helpful, but cannot change the action mapping.
judgeModelLimit: A judge/supervisor model may recommend escalation but cannot override signed findings, an invalid signature, an untrusted signer, or staleness policy. Legacy v2 verdict/keyId handling remains version-scoped.

deterministicHooks.principle: Hooks are deterministic gates, not LLM authority.
deterministicHooks.preActionHook: before any wallet-capable, listing, routing, ACP, or downstream-agent action: require exact signed receipt verification + scope match + staleness check + policy application
deterministicHooks.postVerificationHook: for receipt-v1, store exact JSON plus verifier axes, rulesVersion, slot, receiptId, findings, coverage gaps, and staleness status; keep legacy v2 fields only with a version label
deterministicHooks.summaryHook: block any output that hides gaps/findings, invents a receipt-v1 verdict, omits signature/trust/staleness status, or says safe
deterministicHooks.failureHook: on receipt_unavailable, verifier_error, timeout, 429, 5xx, untrusted signer, or signature failure: mark blocked/deferred
